{{Top|leg}}
'''Vibration-Absorbing Insulation''' was a material used in the construction of [[sonic dampening helmet]]s. The insulation was intended to protect the wearer from the effects of [[Sonic weapon/Legends|sonic weaponry]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
